methodology: Synthetic planning scenario; no production, customer, or billing records.
Weighted representative request shapes retain the modeled token total for each day, model, and tariff. October 2025 uses an assumed 12B tokens.
Anthropic request shapes use a historical aggregate calibration. Other providers and sparse or earlier models use stated simulation assumptions.
The budget target is a comparison only. Costs are calculated from the simulated request token classes and modeled historical tariffs.
Cent rounding is balanced across day, tariff, model, and month to match the exact aggregate rounded to cents. The raw weighted ledger retains exact costs.
Uncached-input baseline assumes all input tokens are billed at standard input price. The 25% scenario markup is illustrative. Excludes taxes, cache storage, tools and monthly service fees.
Image-request metrics and precise within-day timestamps were not modeled. Dates use the Europe/Berlin cohort calendar.
